DCR-geography.rationale: The cited row states a cost but no nationwide availability; free text adds an unrepresented geographic promise.

DCR-geography-positive.rationale: The claim states exactly the cited specialist amount and unit without an additional geographic promise.

DCR-asof.rationale: The free-text date is December 1 but typed as_of is March 1; the declared evidence ends June 30. A matching year cannot establish this date-specific claim.

DCR-asof-positive.rationale: The free-text date and typed March 1 as_of agree, and that date is inside the explicitly stated evidence period.

DCR-condition-swap.rationale: Free text attaches the no-referral condition to hospital and the days restriction to specialist, opposite the typed parts and cited rows. Global condition occurrence is insufficient.

DCR-condition-positive.rationale: Both benefit amounts, units and per-benefit conditions agree with their own cited rows.
